_source: AU Small Finance Bank — API Banking Integration Document, Payout API / Enquiry API, v1.2 (docs/payments_docs/Payout_AU Bank API Banking Integration_V1.2.pdf)
_note: AU resolves a transaction from a COMPOUND key: batchStatusCode (batch level) plus statusCode (inside transactionEnquiryDetails). Neither alone is sufficient — batchStatusCode 00 covers success, failure AND processing. Every combination the document defines is listed in `enquiry`; anything outside it is undefined and must not be guessed.

base_urls._production: shared by the bank only after UAT sign-off

00.meaning: The batch was accepted for processing and a batchNo was issued. This is NOT a payment. Settlement is only confirmed by the Enquiry API returning status PAID.

99.meaning: The batch was rejected outright; read errorMessage / ExtendedErrorDetails for the cause (e.g. 'Duplicate file uploaded.').

enquiry.note: Txn success. No further enquiry. A utr is present.
Txn failed at transaction level. No further enquiry. Read errorCode/errorMessage.
Whole batch failed, so no transaction-level status exists. No further enquiry.
Still in the system, final status not updated. Re-enquire every 5 minutes. DO NOT re-initiate the payment — the money may still move.
Still in the system, final status not updated. Re-enquire every 5 minutes. DO NOT re-initiate the payment — the money may still move.

OPEN.note: Enquiry stage 1 — accepted, not yet processed.

TOBEPROCESSED.note: Enquiry stage 2 — queued for the core banking system.

SENTTOCORE.note: Enquiry stage 2 — handed to core, outcome still unknown.

PAID.note: Enquiry stage 3 — the ONLY status that means the beneficiary was credited. Carries a utr.

PROCESSING.note: statusCode 100/101 — still in the system, final status not updated. Re-enquire every 5 minutes; AU's document states the payment must NOT be re-initiated.

RTGS._max_note: existing workflow limit mapped to the corporate

NEFT.settlement: batched through RBI; 30 min to 2 hours for final status

Internal Fund Transfer.settlement: within AU Small Finance Bank; no IFSC passed

operational_constraints._enquiry_interval_note: The document gives 15 minutes in the process overview and 15-30 in the FAQ, while PROCESSING rows say retry at 5. The 5-minute figure applies specifically to a PROCESSING transaction.
operational_constraints.evening_value_cap: 18:30-00:00 consolidated transactions capped at Rs 1 crore
operational_constraints.payload_encryption: GCM (Galois Counter Mode); GCM-KEY and GCM-SALT (IV) issued by the bank at onboarding. Encryption of the payload is mandatory.
